data.name: Winny
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic elements wīn meaning friend, love or dear and ni meaning kin or family. This name is derived from the Old English word wīnna, meaning to please or to win. In the Middle Ages, it was a pet form of names beginning with Wynne, Wyn, or Wynnebald.
